        cells = [c.text.replace("\n", " / ").strip() for c in row.cells]

tbl_text = ""
for tbl in doc.tables:

            tbl_text += c.text + "\n"
all_text = body_text + "\n" + tbl_text

    hits = []
    for i, p in enumerate(doc.paragraphs):
        if lit in p.text:
            hits.append(f"para P{i}: {p.text[:80]}")
    for ti, tbl in enumerate(doc.tables):
        for ri, row in enumerate(tbl.rows):
            for ci, c in enumerate(row.cells):
                if lit in c.text:
                    hits.append(f"table{ti} r{ri} c{ci}: {c.text[:80]}")
    fh[lit] = hits

for pat in eng_patterns:
    hits = []
    for i, p in enumerate(doc.paragraphs):
        if pat in p.text:
            hits.append(f"para P{i}: {p.text[:100]}")
    eh[pat] = hits

                    if s:

checks["min_body_run_pt"] = min(body_sizes) if body_sizes else None
checks["min_table_run_pt"] = min(tbl_sizes) if tbl_sizes else None

print("t11-1 output code:", checks["table11_1_output_code"], "| has V01:", checks["table11_1_output_code_has_V01"])
